name: setting-row-radio
title: SettingRowRadio
description: Padded settings-row composition for an editable Radio group and its non-interactive saved-value readout.

intent.summary: Padded settings-row composition for an editable Radio group and its non-interactive saved-value readout.
useWhen: A settings card needs a mutually exclusive Radio group as one padded row item.
The same settings card needs to display the saved option without an interactive control in view mode.
avoidWhen: The Radio group is not part of a settings-row surface; compose ds-radio directly.
The setting allows more than one option to be selected; use component:ds-setting-row-checkbox.
The setting is a single immediate on/off choice; use component:ds-setting-row-toggle.
accessibility: Pass the settings heading as the row label. Do not pass Radio groupLabel; the row owns the visible heading and points the slotted radiogroup at it with aria-labelledby.
Keep the Radio group's options, value, required state, and selection event owned by the application. Leave the Radio slotted in view and edit; the row hides it in view.
Do not add a second interaction layer to the row; Radio owns option focus and keyboard selection while settings usage keeps hasInteractionFill false.
View presentation exposes readable label, saved value, and optional supporting copy without radio semantics, a radio toggle, or a focus target.
states: The row is a neutral padded composition; selected, focus, and inactive states belong to the slotted Radio without a choice-list hover or pressed wash.
The owning application handles dsChange and updates the slotted Radio value.
Heading, saved-value choice, and slotted Radio stay mounted. presentation reflects on the host so view/edit is CSS visibility only; do not swap Host children or ngIf the Radio.
View presentation hides the slotted Radio with ::slotted host CSS and shows the saved option label plus optional consequence copy. The Radio stays in the tree.
responsiveBehavior: The row never exceeds its parent width; the slotted Radio keeps its option copy in the flexible column and wraps descriptions when needed.

styling.rationale: The row uses the shared settings-row inline inset so view and edit copy share the same 16px origin, and zeros host padding-block because the heading, choice, and radio options already own vertical spacing. The heading is row-owned CSS, not Radio's form group-label or control section-heading recipe. Radio owns option geometry.

protected.reason: Keep space-200 inline inset in view and edit, with no extra host padding-block.
